verdict.rationale: The Digits Connect API documents write access to the ledger: batch transaction sync, idempotent via external_id, that turns raw financial data into categorized ledger entries, so an agent could push entries programmatically. Nothing shows a manual journal-entry endpoint, a draft/unposted state, or a review queue for API-written entries. The MCP server is explicitly read-only, and the bills submit/approve workflow covers bills, not journal entries. Missing for 10: a documented journal-entry draft/post endpoint, a pending-review queue or approval state for API-created entries routed to an accountant, an agent/MCP write path, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent draft and post journal entries via the API and leave them in a review queue for my accountant

citations.quote: Idempotence and deduplication is handled via the external_id field
